verdict.rationale: Raygun publishes a v3 OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with 46 paths and hosted Swagger UI. The API is described as giving access to Raygun data for use in other tools, and some UI actions, such as source map upload, are explicitly available through the API too. Nothing documents that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature: UI workflows like bulk status changes, ignore rules, CSV export, AI chat and settings toggles are only shown as dashboard actions, and the API is mid-transition with the RUM API kept separately. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of triage, export, settings and AI features, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: allows you to access your Raygun data so that you can display, manipulate and process it in other tools, scripts and applications.
you can also manually upload source maps either through our website using the `JS source map center` or via our API
This is version 3 of Raygun's API. While we transition, the RUM API will remain available
